vision: Deliver a secure, scalable, and robust mobile banking REST API using FastAPI and Python, enabling users to access account data, perform transactions, and manage payments efficiently with JWT-based authentication and OpenAPI 3.0 compliance.
scope: The epic covers the design and implementation of REST endpoints for balance retrieval, transaction history, fund transfers, and bill payments. It includes authentication via JWT tokens, rate limiting, and comprehensive error handling following OpenAPI 3.0 specifications. Out of scope are UI design and third-party payment integrations beyond defined APIs.
success_criteria: All REST endpoints conform to OpenAPI 3.0 specification and pass automated tests.
JWT authentication and rate-limiting mechanisms are implemented and verified against security best practices.

user_stories.title: Retrieve account balance via-secured REST endpoint
user_stories.i_want: to retrieve my current account balance securely
user_stories.so_that: I can view my available funds anytime via the mobile app

acceptance_criteria.given: the user possesses a valid JWT token
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns the current balance in JSON with 200 OK

user_stories.title: Retrieve transaction history REST endpoint
user_stories.i_want: to view my transaction history within a specified date range
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor and verify my financial activity

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has a valid JWT token and provides date filters
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns a paginated transaction list with status 200

user_stories.title: Transfer funds between accounts securely
user_stories.i_want: to transfer funds to another account using secure REST request
user_stories.so_that: I can manage money movement easily and safely

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has a valid JWT token and sufficient balance
acceptance_criteria.when: they initiate a POST request to /transfer with correct recipient info
acceptance_criteria.then: the system processes the transfer and returns transaction confirmation

user_stories.title: Execute bill payment via REST API endpoint
user_stories.i_want: to pay my utility bills using the mobile banking app API
user_stories.so_that: I can settle my bills conveniently on time

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has a valid JWT token and billing details
acceptance_criteria.when: they call the /bills/pay endpoint with payment info
acceptance_criteria.then: the system validates and successfully records the payment

user_stories.title: Implement JWT-based authentication and rate limiting
user_stories.i_want: to integrate JWT tokens and rate-limiting into all endpoints
user_stories.so_that: API requests remain secure and controlled to prevent abuse

acceptance_criteria.given: a user attempts multiple API requests
acceptance_criteria.when: they surpass the rate limit threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: the API returns a 429 Too Many Requests error

acceptance_criteria.given: a user provides a valid JWT
acceptance_criteria.then: access is granted with correct user context

user_stories.title: Provide comprehensive error handling and OpenAPI 3.0 documentation
user_stories.i_want: to ensure all endpoints return structured error responses and are documented per OpenAPI 3.0
user_stories.so_that: developers and integrators can reliably consume and debug the API

acceptance_criteria.given: an invalid request or missing parameter
acceptance_criteria.then: a consistent error message is returned with appropriate HTTP status code
